# English

## v1.17.8

### Changes

#### Features 🎉
* feat(core): add Tencent HY model adapter by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3362
* feat(test): remove automatic credential redaction from run artifacts by @xiong35 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3371
* feat(badge): support skipped test counts by @yuyutaotao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3380

#### Fixes 🐞
* fix(webdriver): enforce request timeout through response body reads by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3232
* fix(web-integration): honor explicit slow swipe durations by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3243
* fix(core): clarify aiScroll node locator guidance by @codeestX in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3353
* fix(core): update vulnerable runtime dependencies by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3356
* fix(badge): don't round a pass rate with failures to 100% by @gjreddy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3343
* fix(test): show paths literally in the GitHub job summary by @gjreddy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3334
* fix(workflow): upgrade security dependencies without overrides by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3358
* fix(android): measure planning-frame age after clock recalibration by @wannT-1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3364
* fix(android): keep the reset packet count in the post-reset timeout error by @gjreddy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3363
* fix(core): handle GPT image-edge bboxes and separate coordinate semantics by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3368
* fix(test): omit misleading badges for failed runs by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3370
* fix(test): keep parentheses in the file path of a failure frame by @gjreddy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3369
* fix(ios): bound scroll gestures and propagate boundary failures by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3253
* fix(harmony): reject reversed and stationary edge scrolls by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3241
* fix(android): reject scrolls without room to move by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3242
* fix(core): add quick mappings for scroll and swipe directions by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3156
* fix(core): deduplicate cumulative planning context by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3254
* fix(test): keep project config stable when filtering test paths by @gjreddy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3332
* fix(web-integration): improve static report playground execution by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3090
* fix(core): preserve invalid System One responses in reports by @EAGzzyCSL in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3379

#### Documentation 📖
* docs(site): add interactive get started guide by @ottomao in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3335
* docs(site): clarify MobileWorld GUI-only scope by @simplyme0823 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/2901

#### Testing 🧪
* test(workflow): finish migration to rstest and document SDK integration by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3359
* test(android): isolate anonymous release asset fallback from CI tokens by @xiong35 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3381

#### CI & Chore ⚙️
* chore(workflow): track midscene-action  v1 tag by @await-ovo in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3350

#### New Contributors
* @gjreddy made their first contribution in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3343
* @wannT-1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3364

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/compare/v1.17

detail.readme:
See interfaces like a human. E2E testing in natural language.
Bring AI vision to E2E testing with a newly designed test framework for web, mobile, and desktop apps.

Website · English / 简体中文

## Write a test in natural language Midscene.js brings AI vision to E2E testing. Describe UI steps and expected results in natural language, then use the visual GUI Agent to carry them out and verify what users see. Organize tests with Midscene Test, or integrate the Agent APIs into your existing testing framework. ### YAML test cases with Midscene Test After [creating a Midscene Test project](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/use) and configuring a model and the Web runtime, write a case like this. Replace the example URL with your app's address: ```yaml beforeEach: - gotoUrl: https://your-shop.example cases: - name: Find headphones under $100 steps: - aiAct: Search for headphones and filter the results to prices under $100 - aiWaitFor: The filtered search results are visible - aiAssert: There are products in the search results, and each costs less than $100 ``` ### JavaScript in your existing tests You can also use the Agent directly in your existing tests. Configure a model and open your app in a Playwright `page`, then describe the same steps in code: ```javascript import { PlaywrightAgent } from '@midscene/web/playwright'; const agent = new PlaywrightAgent(page); await agent.aiAct('Search for headphones and filter the results to prices under $100'); await agent.aiWaitFor('The filtered search results are visible'); await agent.aiAssert('There are products in the search results, and each costs less than $100'); ``` For mobile and desktop apps, use the platform Agent with [Rstest](https://midscenejs.com/sdk/rstest) or [Vitest](https://midscenejs.com/sdk/vitest). Open the generated HTML report to inspect screenshots, element locations, the AI decision process, and action and assertion results. ## 👁️ See, act, and verify like a human E2E testing verifies complete workflows from the user's perspective, so Midscene tests the way a user does: **observe the screen, act on what you see, and verify the visible result**. ### Locate and act from screenshots Midscene locates elements by their appearance and position, then clicks, types, or scrolls to carry out your instructions. You can target icon-only buttons, custom controls, ``, and elements inside cross-origin iframes without maintaining selectors or adding semantic annotations. ### Verify what users see Describe the expected appearance in natural language to check colors, selection highlights, layout, and visual feedback — including content drawn on `` or displayed in native apps. ```javascript await agent.aiAssert('The selected plan has a blue border and a checkmark'); await agent.aiAssert('The error message is visible below the email field'); ``` ## 🌐 One API, across platforms Visual localization does not depend on the UI rendering stack, so the same Agent APIs work on every platform: | Platform | Integration | | --- | --- | | Web | [Playwright](https://midscenejs.com/integrate-with-playwright), [Puppeteer](https://midscenejs.com/integrate-with-puppeteer), or [desktop Chrome](https://midscenejs.com/bridge-mode) | | Android | [Devices and emulators through ADB](https://midscenejs.com/platforms/android) | | iOS | [Devices and simulators through WebDriverAgent](https://midscenejs.com/platforms/ios) | | HarmonyOS | [HarmonyOS NEXT through HDC](https://midscenejs.com/platforms/harmonyos) | | Desktop | [macOS, Windows, and Linux, with remote RDP support](https://midscenejs.com/platforms/desktop) | | Custom interfaces | [Provide screenshots and action capabilities](https://midscenejs.com/integrate-with-any-interface) | ## 📊 Models, cost, and benchmarks ### Choose models for your needs and budget Screenshot-based UI actions avoid sending large DOM trees to the model. In the reported AppControlBench run, Midscene with Doubao Seed 2.1 Turbo passed **58 of 60 tasks with $0.59 in total model cost**. The [report](https://midscenejs.com/app-control-bench-report) provides per-task costs and comparisons across models. Midscene supports GPT, Qwen, Doubao Seed, DeepSeek, Gemini, Kimi, and more, including open-source options you can self-host. See [Model Selection Guide](https://midscenejs.com/model-selection) to choose a model and [Model Configuration](https://midscenejs.com/model-api-setup) to set it up. ### Benchmarks | Benchmark | Pass@1 | Model used in the reported run | | --- | --- | --- | | [AndroidWorld](https://midscenejs.com/android-world-benchmark-report) | 93.1% | Gemini-3.5-Flash | | [MobileWorld](https://midscenejs.com/mobile-world-benchmark-report) | 78.6% | Gemini-3.6-Flash | | [AppControlBench](https://midscenejs.com/app-control-bench-report) | 96.7% | Doubao Seed 2.1 Turbo | Each report includes the run configuration and task results; see AndroidWorld's report for its environment and validator adjustments. Explore [cross-platform showcases](https://midscenejs.com/showcases), from web form validation to mobile workflows and community-built in-vehicle testing. ## 🧩 Midscene Test: a natural-language E2E testing framework [Midscene Test](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/overview) (`@midscene/test`) is a natural-language E2E testing framework. Describe actions and expectations in YAML, and keep logic that needs precise control in TypeScript. ### Test cases maintained by people and AI - **Describe test cases in YAML.** Combine UI actions, assertions, and business operations to express the flow and expected results. - **Reuse business capabilities through TypeScript Nodes.** Wrap data preparation, API calls, and cleanup in Nodes that different cases can share. A refund test can prepare an order through an API, request a refund through the UI, and verify the result in one workflow. - **Generate a Node Spec for developers and AI agents.** Export registered Nodes and their inputs as Markdown, so both can write cases without reading TypeScript. ### Test framework capabilities - **Lifecycle hooks and cleanup:** `setup`, `fileSetup`, `beforeAll`, and `beforeEach` with matching cleanup hooks; cleanup still runs after timeouts or Ctrl+C. - **Retries and timeouts:** case retries, step timeouts, `continue-on-error`, and `bail`. - **Concurrency and isolation:** `maxConcurrentFiles`, with `fileSetup` giving each file its own page, Agent, or device. - **Step-level reports:** screenshots, inputs, outputs, and Agent replay for every step, `#runner-step=last-error` deep links, and `summary.json` for scripts and AI agents. Start with [Create and use test projects](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/use), then learn how to [Develop custom Nodes](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/extend) and control [lifecycle and concurrency](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/execution). Reports, Test results, caches and logs are saved in `midscene_run/`. See [artifact directories](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/running#unified-artifact-root-and-migration) for configuration and CI archiving. ## 🚀 Get started - **Write YAML test cases** — [create a Midscene Test project](https://midscenejs.com/midscene-test/use). - **Add visual capabilities to existing tests** — [Playwright](https://midscenejs.com/integrate-with-playwright) for web apps, [Rstest](https://midscenejs.com/sdk/rstest) or [Vitest](https://midscenejs.com/sdk/vitest) for mobile and desktop apps. - **Try it before writing tests** — the [Chrome extension](https://midscenejs.com/get-started?scene=playground&platform=web) or a [Playground for mobile or desktop](https://midscenejs.com/platforms). - **Run standalone automation scripts** — the [JavaScript SDK](https://midscenejs.com/sdk/standalone). - **Let your AI agent operate the UI** — [Midscene Skills](https://midscenejs.com/skills). ## 📄 Resources * Documentation: [https://midscenejs.com](https://midscenejs.com/) * Sample projects: [midscene-example](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene-example) * API reference: [https://midscenejs.com/reference/#common](https://midscenejs.com/reference/#common) ## 🤝 Community * [Discord](https://discord.gg/2JyBHxszE4) * [Follow us on X](https://x.com/midscene_ai) * [Lark Group (飞书交流群)](https://applink.larkoffice.com/client/chat/chatter/add_by_link?link_token=693v0991-a6bb-4b44-b2e1-365ca0d199ba) ## 🌟 Awesome Midscene Community projects that extend Midscene.js capabilities: * [midscene-ios](https://github.com/lhuanyu/midscene-ios) - iOS Mirror automation support for Midscene * [midscene-pc](https://github.com/Mofangbao/midscene-pc) - PC operation device for Windows, macOS, and Linux * [midscene-pc-docker](https://github.com/Mofangbao/midscene-pc-docker) - Docker image with Midscene-PC server pre-installed * [Midscene-Python](https://github.com/Python51888/Midscene-Python) - Python SDK for Midscene automation * [midscene-java](https://github.com/Master-Frank/midscene-java) by @Master-Frank - Java SDK for Midscene automation * [midscene-java](https://github.com/alstafeev/midscene-java) by @alstafeev - Java SDK for Midscene automation ## 📝 Credits We would like to thank the following projects: - [Rsbuild](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rsbuild) and [Rslib](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rslib) for the build tools. - [UI-TARS](https://github.com/bytedance/ui-tars) for the open-source agent model UI-TARS. - [Qwen-VL](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-VL) for the open-source multimodal model Qwen-VL. - [scrcpy](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) and [yume-chan](https://github.com/yume-chan) for browser-based Android device control. - [appium-adb](https://github.com/appium/appium-adb) for its JavaScript bridge to ADB. - [appium-webdriveragent](https://github.com/appium/WebDriverAgent) for controlling XCTest from JavaScript. - [YADB](https://github.com/ysbing/YADB) for improving text input performance. - [libnut-core](https://github.com/nut-tree/libnut-core) for cross-platform native keyboard and mouse control. - [Puppeteer](https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer) for browser automation and control. - [Playwright](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright) for browser automation, control, and testing. ## 📖 Citation If you use Midscene.js in your research or project, please cite: ```bibtex @software{Midscene.js, author = {Xiao Zhou, Tao Yu, YiBing Lin}, title = {Midscene.js: GUI Agent for E2E Testing.}, year = {2025}, publisher = {GitHub}, url = {https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene} } ``` ## ⭐ Star Midscene If Midscene is useful to you, please give it a star.
